profile.headline: Software Engineer at Savvas Learning Company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an error-label creator in our Python and Grafana-based Test dashboard. This catches Bamboo Build errors and stores them on Opensearch. This system covers 15 Test plans, and processed over 50k Test builds.
- Created a Bazel test runner in Python that generates, collects and stores artifacts generated by a HIL_Tester. Artifacts include Pytest logs from the tester machine, slog2 logs from the DUT, and pcap files from the network data on both the tester machine and DUT. Used it to run 800+ tests to debug DDS issues on a HIL_tester.
- Developed and tested a Python package for a Zoox middle-man board. The board injects faults into CAN channels. It replaces Zoox usage of the DSpace’s DS5331 CAN Gateway Module, which costs about $300 each and has less CAN buses.
- Rewrote a widely-used internal Python package that sends and receive Protobufs to ECUs over RTI DDS. Pushed speed-critical functionality to C++, such as sending periodic messages. The package is used for testing most firmware microcontrollers on the vehicle, such as the motors, brakes, lights, and door ECUs.
- Designed a Vue.js dashboard that displayed Firmware test data from a Django app. Deployed service with Docker, Kubernetes and ArgoCD. Gathered requirements from stakeholders by creating a mock-up application for feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Atlassian Bamboo · Python · Bazel · pytest · Grafana · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote and verified software support in python for a linecard as part of Arista's modular switch system
- Debugged various components of the linecard, such as switch bootup, status LEDs, compatibility with software testing infrastructure, temperature controls, and more.
- Wrote product support and improved on Arista's PID tuning software, which is used to control temperature on switches
- Handled bug fixes and escalations in areas such as environment control, error-reporting, and testing infrastructure.
- Refactored a fan controller chip software that handled voltage sensors, temperature sensors, fans and LEDs.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
‣ Contributed to inverter source code on Gridlab-d, an open-source power grid modeling software
‣ Created Python scripts using IPython notebooks and Pandas to plot Gridlab-d's CSV and XML outputs for lab usage

positions.title: EE16B Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Helped people debug circuits they had to build in lab. 
Examples of circuits and projects I debugged:
Digital to Analog and Analog to Digital Converter
Music Organ: A circuit that turns on lights based on what frequency it hears.
Sixt33n, Speech-controlled car: TI Launchpad-controlled car that took in voice commands to turn either left, right, or straight. We had to work on classifying data we get from the micboard on the circuit, and then use closed loop control to get the car to go straight, right or left.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Developed the backend of a mobile app called MyGreenCar, which records users' fuel/battery consumption and incentivizes more energy-efficient driving
Used Docker to transform a Django/PostgreSQL server into a multi-machine system containing a database, web-framework, broker, and worker — all running on LBNL’s NERSC/Cori supercomputer
Used Django logging, Unix process commands, and Redis to reduce deserializing inefficiencies

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped grade tests and created homework problems for students of Upward Bound. Held study halls to help students with homework.
